tools.name: context_whoami
tools.title: Who Am I
tools.description: Return resolved MCP principal identity and scopes.

tools.name: context_space_list
tools.title: List Spaces
tools.description: List spaces visible to the principal.

tools.name: context_create_space
tools.title: Create Space
tools.description: Create a new space for organizing pages.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case space slug (for example: sales).

tools.name: context_create_shared_page
tools.title: Create Shared Page
tools.description: Create a new page. Fails if the page already exists. Optionally base it on one of the space's templates (see context_space_templates): the template seeds content and metadata defaults, initial `metadata` values are validated against the template's schema, and the page is stamped `template: <name>` so Views can filter by record type.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath.

content.description: Markdown page body. Optional when `template` is given — the template's body seeds the page. Pass title/frontmatter as separate fields; a leading --- frontmatter block is parsed into them instead of being stored in the body.

template.description: Template to base the page on: a name resolved in the page's space (e.g. `event`) or a full `<space>/templates/<name>` path for cross-space use. Applies the template's metadataDefaults and schema field defaults, validates `metadata`, and stamps the page's `template` metadata key.

metadata.description: Initial metadata values applied after create. With `template`, values are validated against the template's metadata schema (types, options, required fields); a violation fails the call and creates nothing.

note.description: Optional change note recorded on the first revision.

tools.name: context_log_receipt
tools.title: Log Receipt
tools.description: Log a receipt for one substantial AI-assisted task into a space that has receipt logging on. Works for every org member, membership or not: the server picks the folder and template, stamps the page as a typed record, and a later call with the same session_ref updates the same receipt (turn count, feedback) instead of creating another. Field options (surface, task_type) come from the space's receipt template; call context_whoami to see the live lists.

space.description: Target space slug. Optional when exactly one space has receipt logging enabled.

request.description: What was asked, one or two lines.

surface.description: Client or harness the work ran in. Built-in options: claude-desktop, claude-code, claude-web, chatgpt, copilot, cursor, gemini, other. The space's template may add more.

task_type.description: Kind of work. Built-in options: research, drafting, coding, analysis, review, planning, admin, other.

model.description: Model id or name, if known.

sources.description: Pages, files, tools or URLs the work drew on.

session_ref.description: Client session or conversation id. Reuse it so later calls update the same receipt.

prompt_excerpt.description: Leave empty unless the organization asked for prompt text.

metadata.description: Extra metadata keys the receipt template allows.

tools.name: context_space_templates
tools.title: List Space Templates
tools.description: Discover a space's page templates — its record types. Each template returns its name, description, informal metadata defaults, (when declared) the normalized metadata schema — typed fields with labels, options, bounds, defaults, and required flags — and its defaultPathPrefix, the directory where records of the type conventionally live (create at `<prefix>/<slug>`). Check this BEFORE creating structured pages (events, deals, prospects, partners, …) so new pages conform to the space's vocabulary and layout; then pass the template name to context_create_shared_page. To declare or change a schema, write the template page's frontmatter.metadataSchema via context_update_shared_page — there is no separate schema tool, and schemaIssues flags a declared-but-broken schema.

spaceSlug.description: Optional lowercase kebab-case space slug filter; omitted lists templates org-wide.

includeContent.description: Include each template's Markdown body (the content scaffold).

tools.name: context_get_shared_page
tools.title: Get Shared Page
tools.description: Fetch a page as Markdown and return a selected version.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath.

version.description: Optional version selector. Supports positive integers and aliases such as latest/first.

includeMetadata.description: Include the page's structured metadata (key-value) in the result.

tools.name: context_get_page_metadata
tools.title: Get Page Metadata
tools.description: Read a page's structured metadata (key-value pairs stored alongside the page), optionally with its change history.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath (use personal/... for personal pages).

includeHistory.description: Also return the metadata change history (audit trail), newest first.

tools.name: context_get_page_links
tools.title: Get Page Links
tools.description: Read a page's link graph: outbound internal links (with broken targets flagged) and backlinks — the pages that link to it. Links are indexed automatically from Markdown bodies on every write.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath (use personal/... for personal pages).

includeBacklinks.description: Include pages linking to this page (default true).

tools.name: context_set_page_metadata
tools.title: Set Page Metadata
tools.description: Merge-patch a page's structured metadata without creating a new page revision. `set` upserts keys (JSON null deletes a key); `append` atomically extends array values (for example a growing sources list). Values may be any JSON type. Setting metadata on a template page (`{space}/templates/{name}`) does NOT declare a record-type schema — use context_update_shared_page to write frontmatter.metadataSchema for that.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath (use personal/... for personal pages).

set.description: Keys to upsert. A JSON null value deletes the key. Other keys are untouched.

append.description: Keys whose array values grow atomically: scalars are pushed, arrays are concatenated; missing keys start as [].

appendUnique.description: Like append, but elements already present are skipped (idempotent — safe for re-run agents). All-duplicate patches are no-ops.

tools.name: context_query_pages_by_metadata
tools.title: Query Pages By Metadata
tools.description: Find pages whose structured metadata matches every filter (AND). Ops: eq, neq, exists, missing, gt, gte, lt, lte (numbers and strings — ISO dates compare correctly), contains (array containment, e.g. does `sources` contain this URL), in / not-in (value equals any / none of a non-empty array of candidates — the OR case, e.g. stage in ["sourcing","diligence"]).

value.description: Comparison value (any JSON). Required except for exists/missing. For contains, a scalar or array of required elements. For in/not-in, a non-empty array of candidate values.

spaceSlug.description: Optional lowercase kebab-case space slug filter.

limit.description: Pages per call (default 20, max 500). The result carries hasMore and nextOffset; pass nextOffset as offset for the next page.

offset.description: Pages to skip before the first returned one (the previous result's nextOffset).

orderBy.description: Sort by a metadata key's value: numbers first (numeric), then strings (ISO dates order correctly), then pages missing the key; ties break by path. Enables top-N queries like highest conviction-score. Exclusive with sort.

sort.description: Sort by a page field instead of a metadata value: `updated` is the page's own last update (a metadata key named updatedAt is unaffected). Ties break by path. Exclusive with orderBy.

includeMetadata.description: Include each matching page's full metadata in the result.

includeReserved.description: Include reserved pages (under agents/ and templates/), excluded by default to keep summaries clean.

includeTotal.description: Also return `total`, the exact number of matching pages across every page of results.

tools.name: context_list_metadata_keys
tools.title: List Metadata Keys
tools.description: Discover the metadata key namespace: distinct keys in use across an org or space with page counts, value types, and last update. Check this BEFORE writing metadata so you reuse existing keys (e.g. confidence-score) instead of inventing near-duplicates.

spaceSlug.description: Optional lowercase kebab-case space slug filter.

limit.description: Maximum keys to return (default 100).

tools.name: get_context_by_url
tools.title: Get Context By URL
tools.description: Fetch a context page by personal/shared URL or canonical path, optionally at a specific version.

url.description: Page URL or canonical path (for example: https://app.example/pages/demo/runbook, /pages/personal/notes/today, or demo/runbook).

version.description: Optional version selector. Supports positive integers and aliases such as latest/first.

includeMetadata.description: Include the page's structured metadata (key-value) in the result.

tools.name: context_list_shared_pages
tools.title: List Shared Pages
tools.description: List pages visible to the principal, optionally filtered by space.

spaceSlug.description: Optional lowercase kebab-case space slug filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 100).

includeReserved.description: Include reserved pages (under agents/ and templates/), excluded by default to keep summaries clean.

tools.name: context_recent_shared_pages
tools.title: Recent Shared Pages
tools.description: List recently updated pages visible to the principal.

spaceSlug.description: Optional lowercase kebab-case space slug filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 20).

includeReserved.description: Include reserved pages (under agents/ and templates/), excluded by default to keep summaries clean.

tools.name: context_get_shared_page_revisions
tools.title: Get Shared Page Revisions
tools.description: List recent revisions for a page path.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath.

limit.description: Maximum number of revisions to return (default 20).

tools.name: context_search_shared_pages
tools.title: Search Shared Pages
tools.description: Search pages visible to the principal.

spaceSlug.description: Optional lowercase kebab-case space slug filter.

limit.description: Result limit.

includeReserved.description: Include reserved pages (under agents/ and templates/), excluded by default to keep summaries clean.

tools.name: context_update_shared_page
tools.title: Update Shared Page
tools.description: Create or update a page with optimistic concurrency. Omit `content` to keep the current body — the safe way to make title- or frontmatter-only changes. Note `frontmatter` REPLACES the stored object, so include every key you want kept. Template pages (`{space}/templates/{name}`) are authored this way too: declare or change a record type by writing frontmatter.metadataSchema (plus metadataDefaults / defaultPathPrefix / description) — there is no separate schema tool.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath.

expectedVersion.description: Required when updating an existing page.

content.description: Markdown page body. OMIT to preserve the current body unchanged (recommended for frontmatter/title-only edits). Pass title/frontmatter as separate fields; a leading --- frontmatter block is parsed into them instead of being stored in the body.

note.description: Optional change note recorded on the revision (why this write happened).

tools.name: context_delete_shared_page
tools.title: Delete Shared Page
tools.description: Permanently delete a shared page (its revisions and metadata go with it). Requires admin access to the space — deletion carries the same bar as the admin console. Not undoable; prefer editing or detaching over deleting when in doubt.

path.description: Canonical path in format spaceSlug/pagePath.

tools.name: context_create_personal_page
tools.title: Create Personal Page
tools.description: Create one page in personal context. Fails if it already exists.

path.description: Relative personal path (for example: notes/today).

content.description: Markdown page body. Pass title/frontmatter as separate fields; a leading --- frontmatter block is parsed into them instead of being stored in the body.

tools.name: context_list_personal_pages
tools.title: List Personal Pages
tools.description: List pages in the caller's personal context.

limit.description: Maximum number of personal pages to return (default 100).

includeReserved.description: Include reserved pages (under agents/ and templates/), excluded by default to keep summaries clean.

tools.name: context_get_personal_page
tools.title: Get Personal Page
tools.description: Fetch one page from personal context by relative path and optional version selector.

path.description: Relative personal path (for example: notes/today).

version.description: Optional version selector. Supports positive integers and aliases such as latest/first.

includeMetadata.description: Include the page's structured metadata (key-value) in the result.

tools.name: context_update_personal_page
tools.title: Update Personal Page
tools.description: Create or update one personal page with optimistic concurrency.

path.description: Relative personal path (for example: notes/today).

expectedVersion.description: Required when updating an existing personal page.

content.description: Markdown page body. Pass title/frontmatter as separate fields; a leading --- frontmatter block is parsed into them instead of being stored in the body.

tools.name: notifications_list
tools.title: List Notifications
tools.description: List the caller's notifications, newest first: changes in spaces they are an editor (or above) of, agent run outcomes there, and — for org admins — access requests and membership changes. Repeated changes to one page fold into a single unread item with a count. Each item carries a one-line summary and the page path to open. People only: agent credentials have no inbox.

limit.description: Items per page (default 20).

before.description: Cursor: items that occurred before this ISO-8601 instant (pass nextBefore from a previous call).

tools.name: notifications_mark_read
tools.title: Mark Notifications Read
tools.description: Mark notifications read — by id (from notifications_list), or every one with all=true. Idempotent.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.title: List Space Agents
tools.description: List every visible space's agent: instructions status, task count, run count, and last run. Each space (including personal) has exactly one agent.

tools.name: agent_list_tasks
tools.title: List Agent Tasks
tools.description: List agent tasks (pages under agents/, excluding instructions and run records), optionally filtered by space. Includes per-task run stats and schedule state.

spaceSlug.description: Optional space slug filter (use personal for the personal space).

limit.description: Maximum tasks to return (default 50).

tools.name: agent_get_task
tools.title: Get Agent Task
tools.description: Fetch one agent task: full Markdown instructions, frontmatter (including schedule), run stats, and its most recent runs.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

includeRuns.description: Include the task's most recent runs (default true).

tools.name: agent_list_available_models
tools.title: List Available Agent Models
tools.description: List the models available for agent task runs (what /admin/agents stores): the admin-enabled model ids and the organization default. Pin one on a task by setting its id as the model frontmatter key via agent_create_task / agent_update_task; tasks without a pinned model follow the organization default.

tools.name: agent_create_task
tools.title: Create Agent Task
tools.description: Create a new agent task in a space (a page at <space>/agents/<task>). Fails if the task already exists. Scheduling uses the schedule / scheduleTz / scheduleEnabled frontmatter keys (5-field cron, daily granularity with day-of-week selection); the model frontmatter key pins one of the admin-enabled models (see agent_list_available_models).

spaceSlug.description: Space slug to create the task in (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest). 'instructions' and 'runs/...' are reserved.

content.description: Markdown task instructions the agent executes on each run.

frontmatter.description: Optional frontmatter (e.g. schedule: '0 9 * * 1,2,3,4,5' — day-of-week as * or a comma list — plus scheduleTz, scheduleEnabled; model: <id> pins an admin-enabled model, see agent_list_available_models).

tools.name: agent_update_task
tools.title: Update Agent Task
tools.description: Update an existing agent task's instructions, title, or frontmatter (including schedule keys, and the model key pinning an admin-enabled model — see agent_list_available_models) with optimistic concurrency. Fails if the task does not exist — use agent_create_task to create one.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

expectedVersion.description: Current task version (from agent_get_task); required for the update to apply.

frontmatter.description: Replacement frontmatter (omit to keep current values; model: <id> pins an admin-enabled model, see agent_list_available_models).

tools.name: agent_run_task
tools.title: Run Agent Task
tools.description: Trigger a task run through the deployment's run pipeline and wait for the outcome. The run executes as the space's agent principal and writes a run record under agents/runs/. If the call times out, the run continues — poll agent_list_runs / agent_get_run for the outcome.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

tools.name: agent_list_runs
tools.title: List Task Runs
tools.description: List a task's run records, newest first: status, trigger, timing, model, token usage, turns, and summary. Useful for evals — see EVALS-GUIDE.md.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

limit.description: Maximum runs to return (default 20).

tools.name: agent_get_run
tools.title: Get Task Run
tools.description: Fetch one run record in full: status, timing, model, token usage, turn count, the run's Markdown output, and (opt-in) the structured activity transcript (reasoning, tool calls, per-step usage).

path.description: Full run record path (<space>/agents/runs/<task>/<run-id>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task + runId.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

includeTranscript.description: Include the structured activity transcript (can be large; default false).

tools.name: agent_get_instructions
tools.title: Get Agent Instructions
tools.description: Read a space agent's persona (agents/instructions) — the standing guidance layered into every run.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug (use personal for the personal space).

tools.name: agent_set_instructions
tools.title: Set Agent Instructions
tools.description: Create or update a space agent's persona (agents/instructions) with optimistic concurrency (expectedVersion required when it already exists).

spaceSlug.description: Space slug (use personal for the personal space).

tools.title: List Personal Pages
tools.description: List pages in the caller's personal context.

limit.description: Maximum number of personal pages to return (default 100).

includeReserved.description: Include reserved pages (under agents/ and templates/), excluded by default to keep summaries clean.

tools.name: context_get_personal_page
tools.title: Get Personal Page
tools.description: Fetch one page from personal context by relative path and optional version selector.

path.description: Relative personal path (for example: notes/today).

version.description: Optional version selector. Supports positive integers and aliases such as latest/first.

includeMetadata.description: Include the page's structured metadata (key-value) in the result.

tools.name: context_update_personal_page
tools.title: Update Personal Page
tools.description: Create or update one personal page with optimistic concurrency.

path.description: Relative personal path (for example: notes/today).

expectedVersion.description: Required when updating an existing personal page.

content.description: Markdown page body. Pass title/frontmatter as separate fields; a leading --- frontmatter block is parsed into them instead of being stored in the body.

tools.name: notifications_list
tools.title: List Notifications
tools.description: List the caller's notifications, newest first: changes in spaces they are an editor (or above) of, agent run outcomes there, and — for org admins — access requests and membership changes. Repeated changes to one page fold into a single unread item with a count. Each item carries a one-line summary and the page path to open. People only: agent credentials have no inbox.

limit.description: Items per page (default 20).

before.description: Cursor: items that occurred before this ISO-8601 instant (pass nextBefore from a previous call).

tools.name: notifications_mark_read
tools.title: Mark Notifications Read
tools.description: Mark notifications read — by id (from notifications_list), or every one with all=true. Idempotent.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.title: List Space Agents
tools.description: List every visible space's agent: instructions status, task count, run count, and last run. Each space (including personal) has exactly one agent.

tools.name: agent_list_tasks
tools.title: List Agent Tasks
tools.description: List agent tasks (pages under agents/, excluding instructions and run records), optionally filtered by space. Includes per-task run stats and schedule state.

spaceSlug.description: Optional space slug filter (use personal for the personal space).

limit.description: Maximum tasks to return (default 50).

tools.name: agent_get_task
tools.title: Get Agent Task
tools.description: Fetch one agent task: full Markdown instructions, frontmatter (including schedule), run stats, and its most recent runs.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

includeRuns.description: Include the task's most recent runs (default true).

tools.name: agent_list_available_models
tools.title: List Available Agent Models
tools.description: List the models available for agent task runs (what /admin/agents stores): the admin-enabled model ids and the organization default. Pin one on a task by setting its id as the model frontmatter key via agent_create_task / agent_update_task; tasks without a pinned model follow the organization default.

tools.name: agent_create_task
tools.title: Create Agent Task
tools.description: Create a new agent task in a space (a page at <space>/agents/<task>). Fails if the task already exists. Scheduling uses the schedule / scheduleTz / scheduleEnabled frontmatter keys (5-field cron, daily granularity with day-of-week selection); the model frontmatter key pins one of the admin-enabled models (see agent_list_available_models).

spaceSlug.description: Space slug to create the task in (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest). 'instructions' and 'runs/...' are reserved.

content.description: Markdown task instructions the agent executes on each run.

frontmatter.description: Optional frontmatter (e.g. schedule: '0 9 * * 1,2,3,4,5' — day-of-week as * or a comma list — plus scheduleTz, scheduleEnabled; model: <id> pins an admin-enabled model, see agent_list_available_models).

tools.name: agent_update_task
tools.title: Update Agent Task
tools.description: Update an existing agent task's instructions, title, or frontmatter (including schedule keys, and the model key pinning an admin-enabled model — see agent_list_available_models) with optimistic concurrency. Fails if the task does not exist — use agent_create_task to create one.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

expectedVersion.description: Current task version (from agent_get_task); required for the update to apply.

frontmatter.description: Replacement frontmatter (omit to keep current values; model: <id> pins an admin-enabled model, see agent_list_available_models).

tools.name: agent_run_task
tools.title: Run Agent Task
tools.description: Trigger a task run through the deployment's run pipeline and wait for the outcome. The run executes as the space's agent principal and writes a run record under agents/runs/. If the call times out, the run continues — poll agent_list_runs / agent_get_run for the outcome.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

tools.name: agent_list_runs
tools.title: List Task Runs
tools.description: List a task's run records, newest first: status, trigger, timing, model, token usage, turns, and summary. Useful for evals — see EVALS-GUIDE.md.

path.description: Full task page path (<space>/agents/<task>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

limit.description: Maximum runs to return (default 20).

tools.name: agent_get_run
tools.title: Get Task Run
tools.description: Fetch one run record in full: status, timing, model, token usage, turn count, the run's Markdown output, and (opt-in) the structured activity transcript (reasoning, tool calls, per-step usage).

path.description: Full run record path (<space>/agents/runs/<task>/<run-id>). Alternative to spaceSlug + task + runId.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug the agent belongs to (use personal for the personal space).

task.description: Task path under agents/ (for example: daily-digest or reports/weekly).

includeTranscript.description: Include the structured activity transcript (can be large; default false).

tools.name: agent_get_instructions
tools.title: Get Agent Instructions
tools.description: Read a space agent's persona (agents/instructions) — the standing guidance layered into every run.

spaceSlug.description: Space slug (use personal for the personal space).

tools.name: agent_set_instructions
tools.title: Set Agent Instructions
tools.description: Create or update a space agent's persona (agents/instructions) with optimistic concurrency (expectedVersion required when it already exists).

spaceSlug.description: Space slug (use personal for the personal space).
